entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return something. I bought a VeloBand Pulse a couple of weeks ago, and it's just not working out for me. Can I send it back?
I can certainly help you with that. Could you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your purchase?
It's [customer email address]. Look, I don't have all day. I just want to know if I can return this VeloBand Pulse or not. It’s been about 15 days.
Thank you. I've located your order. I understand you'd like to return your VeloBand Pulse. Let me check our return policy for you. I want to make sure that we can get this sorted out swiftly
Well, get a move on! I'm not sure what the return policy is, but I've had other smart watch products with you before and never had this problem.

Okay, one moment... Alright, I see here that our standard return policy allows for returns within 90 days of purchase. So, you are well within that timeframe. You can absolutely return your VeloBand Pulse.
Ninety days? Seriously? Why did I think it was such a short window! Good! So, what do I need to do?

I apologize for any confusion regarding the return policy. To initiate the return, I'll send you a prepaid shipping label to your email address. Simply pack the VeloBand Pulse securely in its original packaging, affix the label, and drop it off at any authorized carrier location. Once we receive the returned item, we'll process a full refund to your original method of payment.
Great, that sounds easy enough. Will I get the shipping label right away?

Yes, the shipping label will be sent to your email address within the next few minutes. Please allow up to 7-10 business days for the refund to appear in your account after we receive the return. This is standard procedure. Is there anything else that I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's everything. Thanks for the help. It's a relief to know the return policy is a full 90 days and not just 10 days!
You're very welcome! We are glad we could help. If you need anything else in the future, don't hesitate to reach out. Have a great day!
